LanguageData.OWT_SettingSelfServiceDesc: Customers will buy from an unattended counter instead of walking out. Convenient, but every self-service sale quietly erodes the town's reputation — nobody remembers a shop nobody works.
LanguageData.OWT_CmdEvictGuestDesc: Release this bed's current guest immediately. They lose the room they already paid for — a guest evicted this way won't come back to this hotel for the rest of their visit.
LanguageData.OWT_CmdOpenDesc: When open, customers may browse and buy from this counter. Closing it does not stop your colonists using the room.
LanguageData.OWT_CmdMarkupDesc: Set what this business charges, as a percentage of an item's market value. Cheaper shops win customers away from rivals; dearer ones make more per sale.
LanguageData.OWT_CmdCollectDesc: Empty the till onto the floor beside the counter, where a hauler can pick it up.
LanguageData.OWT_CmdLedgerDesc: How the town is trading: appeal, reputation, today's business, and every shop's takings. Appeal drives how often customers arrive and how much silver they carry.
LanguageData.OWT_LedgerAppealLine: Appeal: {0} — customers start arriving at 0.5; the higher it climbs, the more often they come and the richer they are. Grow it with more distinct, well-stocked, open businesses.
LanguageData.OWT_LedgerReputationLine: Reputation: {0} — served customers raise it; walkouts and self-service sales erode it. It sways both what customers will pay and how many come.
LanguageData.OWT_LedgerRegularLine: Customers from {0} have become regulars ({1} standing).
LanguageData.OWT_LedgerColdLine: Customers from {0} want nothing more to do with this town ({1} standing).
LanguageData.OWT_TabStockHeader: Offered for sale ({0} on the shelves)
LanguageData.OWT_LetterCustomersText: {0} travellers from {1} have heard there is business to be done here, and have come to spend.\n\nThey will browse whatever your open shops have on display and pay across the counter — if there is someone there to serve them.
LanguageData.OWT_CustomersScared: Violence in town. The customers from {0} are leaving.
LanguageData.OWT_CustomerWalkedOut: {0} gave up waiting at {1} and left the goods behind. Word of the poor service spreads.
LanguageData.OWT_CustomerWalkedOutService: {0} gave up waiting at {1} and left. Word of the poor service spreads.
LanguageData.OWT_GuestEvicted: {0}'s room at {1} was taken from them. Word of the poor treatment spreads.
LanguageData.OWT_AlertUnattendedDesc: Customers are queueing at a counter with nobody behind it. If a colonist with the Shopkeeping work type doesn't serve them soon, they will walk out — losing you the sale and hurting the town's reputation.
LanguageData.OWT_FalseFrontIdle: No open shop nearby to advertise for
LanguageData.OWT_CmdAssignSheriffDesc: Assign a colonist to hold this post as sheriff. While they're on duty here, patrons town-wide get rowdy more slowly, and the sheriff can step in to calm a specific patron down before they cause a disturbance.
LanguageData.OWT_PostAlreadyFilled: This post is already filled. Unassign its current holder first.
LanguageData.OWT_SaloonTrouble: {0} caused a scene at {1}. Word of the disturbance spreads, and they've had enough for one visit.
LanguageData.OWT_AlertRowdyPatronsDesc: A patron is getting loud. If nothing steps in, it will turn into a disturbance — losing you their custom for the rest of their visit and hurting the town's reputation. An assigned, on-duty sheriff can calm them down first.
LanguageData.OWT_CmdHouseEdgeDesc: Set how much of every wager the house expects to keep on average. A low edge keeps the table fair and patrons happy; a high one wins the house more per hand but pays out less often, and angers losers faster.
LanguageData.OWT_CheatingAccusation: {0} accuses the dealer at {1} of cheating after a bad hand.
LanguageData.OWT_HouseCantCover: {0} won big at {1}, but the house can only cover {2} of the {3} owed. The table closes its doors until someone reopens it.
LanguageData.OWT_CmdCollectDescWager: Empty the till onto the floor beside the counter. This till also backs every future payout — emptying it can leave the house unable to cover the next win.
